purpose: Run the Sender's Polling Runs: coalesce background, foreground, and manual triggers into durable identified runs; recover and checkpoint an interrupted run before reading again; fairly schedule per-type traversal of snapshots and Change Cycles, bounded by a relative budget, an absolute deadline, or both, through the published readers, staging units, and begin units; pause, block, defer, retry, or escalate each record type by its exact condition; and close every run with one health-data-free Sync Checkpoint. Version 3 adds opt-in quiet change reads: after a type's catch-up cycle, a new Change Cycle's first read that finds nothing advances the change origin through stage-outbox-batch@2 and stages no message, and the type reports no-change.

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: One background, foreground, or manual trigger, with an optional execution budget in milliseconds, an optional absolute deadline on the coordinator's monotonic clock, and, for a manual trigger, optional record types to move forward once.

inputs.name: retry_intent
inputs.description: The Operator's Sender-side request to retry one record type blocked by a Projection Refusal; never accepted from the Portal.

inputs.name: managed_record_types
inputs.description: The record types the Sender collects under its capability generation, each supported by that generation at the Sender's projection schema version.

inputs.name: projection_versions
inputs.description: The Sender build's projection-implementation version and each managed type's projection schema version, as the Kotlin readers project with.

inputs.name: concurrency
inputs.description: The cross-type traversal pool size, a positive integer defaulting to two.

inputs.name: staging_context
inputs.description: The active Sender Installation, its installation key alias, and its capability generation, read once when a run opens, as the staging units use them.

inputs.name: sync_conditions
inputs.description: Whether collection is enabled, whether the Device keeps a secure screen lock, whether a Delivery Block holds the Outbox, and whether storage pressure stops polling, read before every step.

inputs.name: background_scheduling_status
inputs.description: The Background Scheduling Status observed when a run opens: available, restricted, or unregistered.

inputs.name: source_readers
inputs.description: The TypeScript seams over read-snapshot-page@1, read-change-page@1, and the begin units' changes-token issuer, whose results the coordinator validates as bridge payloads. With quiet change reads enabled, an empty, final first read of a new Change Cycle is advanced rather than staged once the type's catch-up cycle has finished.

inputs.name: installation_cipher
inputs.description: The 3ug InstallationCipher seam, used only through the staging units.

inputs.name: sender_storage
inputs.description: The Sender's SQLite database: this unit's run, ring, cycle, and block records, and the published units' state read only through their exported functions.

inputs.name: clocks_and_identity
inputs.description: The Sender wall clock for run times and attempt dates, a monotonic clock for elapsed duration, budgets, and absolute deadlines, and the version 4 UUID source for snapshot and Change Cycle identities.

outputs.name: run_checkpointed
outputs.description: A Polling Run opened durably before any read and closed with exactly one Sync Checkpoint through stage-sync-checkpoint@1, reporting every managed type's lifecycle outcome, allowlisted reason, and source-data-staged flag. A run whose deadline has passed when it opens still checkpoints, with every type deferred with time-budget-reached.

outputs.name: recovered_run
outputs.description: A run left open by an earlier process or failure, closed as interrupted and checkpointed before any new run reads.

outputs.name: staged_progress
outputs.description: Snapshot and Change Cycle pages, Snapshot and Change Completions, and Initial and Reconciliation Snapshot attempts, each committed by its owning unit; positions advance only through that staging. With quiet change reads enabled, an empty, final first change read after the catch-up cycle instead advances the change origin through stage-outbox-batch@2, with no Ingest Batch and no Change Completion.

outputs.name: type_block
outputs.description: A health-data-free Projection Refusal or oversized-record block on one record type, keyed by its identity, that later runs skip until the identity changes or the Operator requests one retry.

outputs.name: run_failure
outputs.description: A cipher, storage, conflict, or state-mismatch failure that stops the run before its checkpoint and leaves it open for recovery.

outputs.name: retry_refusal
outputs.description: A retry intent for a type that no Projection Refusal blocks, with nothing written.

observable_effects.name: health-connect-read
observable_effects.description: Through the reader and issuer seams, reads snapshot and change pages and issues pre-read changes tokens; never writes to Health Connect or requests permissions.

observable_effects.name: installation-key-seal
observable_effects.description: Seals only through stage-outbox-batch@1, stage-sync-completion@1, and stage-sync-checkpoint@1; never calls the cipher itself.

observable_effects.name: sender-storage-write
observable_effects.description: Applies this unit's Sender schema migration and writes its own run, ring, cycle, and block records; every other write is a published unit's own transaction.

owns: opening, recovering, and closing Polling Runs, their run sequences, and their per-type outcomes, reasons, and source-data-staged flags
trigger coalescing into at most one follow-up run, and one-time manual priority
the per-type traversal order, the cross-type pool, and the durable round-robin ring
deciding each type's next step: begin, read, stage, complete, skip, pause, or escalate
Projection Refusal and oversized-record block identities, their automatic retry rule, and the Operator's one retry
soft-deadline enforcement from a relative budget, an absolute deadline, or both, including how coalesced triggers combine them, and the collection-disabled, permission-gap, and condition pauses
choosing a new Initial Snapshot or a Reconciliation Snapshot after lost continuity
validating reader and issuer results as bridge payloads
does_not_own: reading Health Connect, projecting records, positions, token age, and permission checks, which belong to read-snapshot-page, read-change-page, and project-source-record
snapshot attempts and their pre-read tokens, which belong to begin-initial-snapshot and begin-reconciliation-snapshot
partitioning, sealing, the Outbox, and cycle progress, which belong to stage-outbox-batch
completion and checkpoint messages and their exactly-once records, which belong to stage-sync-completion and stage-sync-checkpoint
the Wire Protocol message formats and closed value lists, which belong to ingest-protocol

background registration, the eight-minute window, and Background Scheduling Status, which belong to schedule-background-polling; the Sender shell turns that window into a background trigger's absolute deadline
enrollment, capability adoption, drain mode, the secure-lock requirement, and the installation key, which belong to manage-sender-enrollment
delivery, Delivery Blocks, and receipt-bound removal, which belong to send-outbox-message
detecting storage pressure and secure-lock removal, which the Sender shell supplies as conditions
the Expo bridge between the Kotlin readers and TypeScript
